SHIONTHEBRUISER-DAMAGE_CAP.title: Damage Cap
SHIONTHEBRUISER-DAMAGE_CAP.description: Each hit of this Attack can only deal up to [blue]{DamageCap}[/blue] damage.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_HIT.title: Critical
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_HIT.description: [gold]Critical Hits[/gold] deal 50% more damage. Relics, powers and Shion's attacks can all influence the chance of a Critical Hit occuring per Hit or Attack.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_DRAW.title: Critical Draw
SHIONTHEBRUISER-CRITICAL_DRAW.descriptio:
When you draw this card from your Draw Pile, increase [gold]Critical Hits[/gold] chance by [blue]{CriticalDraw}[/blue]% for the rest of the turn.
This effect can only contribute to 50% Critical Hit chance per turn.
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PATCH_UP.title: Patch Up
SHIONTHEBRUISER-PATCH_UP.description:
Heal for {PatchUp:cond:>0?[blue]{PatchUp}[/blue] HP|the amount specified}.
This healing cannot put you above [blue]50%[/blue] of your Max HP.
